subject: Occupational and Physical Therapy Services
overview: District occupational and physical therapy specialists presented an overview of school-based therapy services, evaluation procedures, and student supports across all grade levels from preschool through post-secondary transition.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Meeting organizers introduced district therapy staff presenting on occupational and physical therapy in Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Overview of OT and PT Roles Under IDEA
items.summary: Presenters outlined district staffing, professional credentialing, and how therapy services function as support under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act compared to medical models.

items.title: Preschool Therapy Evaluation and Delivery
items.summary: Staff detailed early evaluation procedures starting at age two and a half, collaborative arena evaluations, and push-in therapy integrated directly into preschool classroom routines.

items.title: Elementary and Middle School Therapy Services
items.summary: The presentation covered support for expanding writing, organizational, self-regulation, and environmental demands as students progress through elementary and middle school.

items.title: High School and Post-Secondary Transition
items.summary: Presenters reviewed transition planning starting at age 14, emphasizing student self-determination, independent living skills, community navigation, and Project Transition supports up to age 22.

items.title: Physical Therapy, Specialized Equipment, and PE Integration
items.summary: Staff explained physical therapy assessments, customized mobility equipment, and methods for including students in physical education classes and recess.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Organizers shared contact details for audience questions and concluded the meeting.
